nodes.label: Conventional Commits convention
nodes.rationale: Prismio follows Conventional Commits (<type>(<scope>): <desc>). Types: feat/fix/test/docs/refactor/chore/perf. Scope names the compiler component (lexer, parser, ir, ast, bridge, runtime, tests). Chosen to keep history scannable and changes focused.

nodes.label: Prismio Project Structure (src/ layout)
nodes.rationale: Documents the compiler pipeline file layout: main.psm=entry/import resolver, lexer.psm=tokenizer, token.psm=token defs, keywords.psm=keyword defs, parser.psm=top-level parser, parser_decls.psm=declaration parsing, parser_expr.psm=expression parsing, ast.psm=AST node defs, ir.psm=IR generator, bridge.psm=extern fn decls for llvm-bridge, utils.psm=shared utilities.

nodes.label: Claim: no dedicated semantic analysis pass (planned)
nodes.rationale: CONTRIBUTING.md states: 'The compiler currently performs no dedicated semantic analysis pass between parsing and IR generation — type information is resolved structurally during the IR walk. A dedicated analysis phase is planned.' This appears to be stale relative to the current source: src/sema.psm already implements a full analyze_module semantic-analysis pass (type checking, overload resolution, move/borrow/drop checking) and src/main.psm's compile_source explicitly invokes analyze_module(merged_ast) before IR generation.
nodes.norm_label: claim: no dedicated semantic analysis pass (planned)

nodes.label: Test naming convention (test_<NN>_<description>.psm)
nodes.rationale: Each test must be self-contained (only depends on utils.psm), exit 0 on success, and cover one scoped language behavior; the runner treats any non-zero exit as failure.

nodes.label: Prismio Design Principles
nodes.rationale: Explicit over implicit (mutability/types/allocation visible at call site); C ABI as the FFI (no bindings layer, no marshalling); Self-hosting as a design constraint (language must be expressive enough to implement its own compiler); LLVM as the backend (no custom codegen, full access to LLVM optimization passes and targets).

nodes.label: Documented Compiler Pipeline (README architecture diagram)
nodes.rationale: Source(.psm) -> Lexer(src/lexer.psm) -> Parser(src/parser.psm) -> Import Resolver(src/main.psm, flattens transitive imports) -> IR Generator(src/ir.psm, AST walk to LLVM IR text, delegates emission to llvm-bridge via extern fn) -> llvm-llc -> Clang(links runtime.c) -> Native binary. Notably omits a semantic-analysis stage.

nodes.label: Claim: no semantic analysis pass between parsing and IR gen (planned)
nodes.rationale: README states type information is resolved structurally during the IR walk and a dedicated analysis phase is planned - same claim as CONTRIBUTING.md, also apparently stale given src/sema.psm's existing analyze_module pass wired into src/main.psm.
nodes.norm_label: claim: no semantic analysis pass between parsing and ir gen (planned)

nodes.label: Responsible vulnerability disclosure process
nodes.rationale: Security issues must be reported privately via security@prismio.org, not public GitHub issues. Target timeline: acknowledge within 48 hours, initial assessment within 7 days. Disclosure should stay private until verified, fixed, and coordinated.

nodes.label: Security policy scope
nodes.rationale: Covers the Prismio compiler, runtime library, LLVM bridge layer, package/build tooling, and official Prismio infrastructure/repositories; third-party/LLVM vulnerabilities go to their own maintainers.

nodes.label: NodeKind enum (AST node kinds)
nodes.rationale: Comment: 'These must match the C++ compiler's NodeType enum for debugging' - evidence the self-hosted Prismio compiler was bootstrapped from / kept in parity with an earlier C++ implementation not present in this repo.

nodes.label: ASTNode struct (flat, string-pointer-punned)
nodes.rationale: Flat AST node representation using String fields as type-punned pointers (child1/child2/child3/next/type_info) instead of native pointers/references, worked around via ptr_to_node/node_to_ptr extern FFI helpers.

nodes.label: LLVM Bridge FFI declarations (bridge.psm)
nodes.rationale: Pure extern fn declaration surface for llvm-bridge.c. README: 'IR emission is handled by llvm-bridge.c ... The compiler calls into it exclusively via extern fn declarations in src/bridge.psm. There is no direct LLVM API dependency in the Prismio source.'

nodes.label: fn is_keyword(s) -> Bool
nodes.rationale: Comment: 'Keywords from keywords.cpp' - mirrors an earlier C++ compiler's keyword table, same bootstrap-parity pattern seen in ast.psm's NodeKind.
